notes.title: Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Graphical improvements throughout the game.
Improvements in the tutorial dynamics and also the glitch bug in the Portuguese language has been fixed.
other minor gameplay bugs have also been fixed.

notes.title: New Achievement and bug fixes
notes.notes:
The first One Pixel Achievement has finally been added !!
who will conquer it first?

Space button bug fixed.

notes.title: Improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Buttons have been added to return to the menu and exit the game.
Options have been added for you to take the initial conversations and during the game (Separately)
Now the AWSD control model works to make the tutorial (Mouse too)
Pressing the "E" button does not make you leave the game anymore.
And some minor bugs have also been fixed.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: Now the music from the home menu is playing endlessly (Bug fixed)
